title: Hook
text: Imagine looking up at the sky tonight, and instead of seeing our tiny silver Moon, you see massive alien worlds hanging above your head like giant glowing globes.
nxt: This breathtaking sky may be real in a planetary system located forty light-years away called TRAPPIST-1.

title: Seven Worlds
text: All seven planets orbit closer to their host star than Mercury orbits our Sun.
nxt: Because they are crowded so close together, if you stood on the surface of TRAPPIST-1e, your neighboring sibling worlds would look larger in your sky than the full Moon looks from Earth.
